senses.gloss: धुशुल्या धुशुल्या (?), f., N. of a river.

धुस्तुर धुस्तुर or धुस्तूर, अस्, m. the
thorn-apple, Datura Fastuosa; [cf. धत्तूर.]

धूस्तूर धूस्तूर, अस्, m. = धुस्तूर, the
thorn-apple, Datura Metel and Fastuosa.

धूश् धूश् or धूष् or धूस् (perhaps a
Prākṛt form of धृष् for हृष्), cl. 10.
P. धूशयति, धूषयति, धूसयति, &c., to
make splendid or elegant; to embellish.

धूषर धूषर, a wrong spelling for धू-
सर below.

धूसर धूसर, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. ध्वस् for
ध्वंस्, cf. ध्वसिर; but said to be fr. rt. 1. धू
and connected with धूलि, q. v.), of a dusty or
greyish or dusty-white colour, grey; (अस्), m. grey
(the colour); a jackass, a donkey; a camel; a pigeon;
an oilman; anything of a grey tint; (आ), f., N. of a
small shrub, = पाण्डुर-फली; (ई), f., N. of a Kin-
narī or female chorister of heaven.
—धूसर-च्छ-
दा, f. a kind of plant, = श्वेत-वुह्ना.
—धूसर-
त्व, अम्, n. grey colour, paleness; (also read धू-
षर-त्व.)
—धूसर-पत्त्रिका, f. the plant Tragia
Involucrata [cf. उष्ट्र-धूसर, पुच्छिका]; a kind
of Heliotropium (= हस्ति-शुण्डी).
धूसरक, अस्, m., N. of a jackal.
धूसरित, अस्, आ, अम्, made grey, greyish.
